explanation: Schur's theorem: the Galois group over ℚ of the truncated exponential Σ_{j≤n} x^j/j! is A_n when 4 ∣ n and S_n otherwise (n ≥ 2). This is the classical result (Schur 1930; Coleman's later proof); the docstring's year "1924" is slightly off but irrelevant. The polynomial definition is correct. The statement is correct and solved.
